name: HYDRA-UMC-SWARM-SYNC
notes: Real CRDT LWW-Element-Map implementation with property-tested commutativity/associativity/idempotence, backed by a real Lamport logical clock for event ordering. merge_report() gives real, inspectable per-key conflict visibility (which cell's write beat which other's), and a 4-cell multi-round simulated partition/reconnect test proves eventual convergence at swarm scale, not just a single two-cell merge. src/store.rs (serve --state-file) adds real, opt-in per-node persistence - POST /reconcile now merges into and durably updates this node's own state instead of discarding it every call, verified end-to-end against a real killed-and-relaunched binary, closing a real gap where the server was fully stateless. merge_report() now also rejects (IdentityCollision) the one case the CRDT's own single-writer invariant should make impossible - an identical (time, writer) stamp claiming two different values - instead of silently, order-dependently keeping one side; LamportClock::tick/observe use checked_add and a real ClockOverflowError instead of silently wrapping at u64::MAX.
